metadata.question: Was the PM2.5 higher over Wuhan, China in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.exec_msg:
Feb 2019 - Images: 2608, Valid Pixels: 623, Mean AOD: 0.728
Feb 2020 - Images: 2702, Valid Pixels: 1467, Mean AOD: 0.532
Evidence: Mean AOD (proxy for PM2.5) was NOT higher in Feb 2020 than Feb 2019.
B
